content.text: Targeted keyword sweeps confirm the absence: "solicit" and "induce" return zero hits, and every "hire"/"employ"/"personnel" hit is unrelated (indemnity for acts of hired third parties, employee-related confidentiality, independent-contractor language, and data-access controls).

input.quote: (c) The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: No non-solicit binds the Customer, which is the rule's preferred position, so no redline is proposed. I read the entire agreement (single "Preamble" section, p0000-p0074) and ran targeted sweeps: "solicit" and "induce" return zero hits, and every "hire", "employ" and "personnel" hit is unrelated - indemnity for the acts of third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a party's control (p0051, p0052), employee-directed confidentiality handling (p0056, p0061), the independent-contractor provision (p0066), and database access limited to "authorized personnel" (p0035, p0045). The General Provisions (p0063-p0073) cover governing law, publicity, independent contractor status, fees, notices, severability/survival, force majeure and assignment, and the survival list in p0070 (confidentiality, proprietary rights, indemnification, limitations of liability, effects of termination, governing law) includes no restrictive covenant. Nothing therefore restricts our ability to hire or approach Vendor personnel. The deterministic sub-checks for duration and a general-solicitation carve-out are unmet only because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; that absence is the outcome we want, not a deviation. Recorded internally: if the Vendor introduces a non-solicit on redraft, accept no more than the fallback - mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
